issues.concern: The top-level gloss is incomplete; it only lists 'fiscal year, academic year' but the headword can also refer to a general 'year' in a broader sense, not strictly fiscal or academic.
issues.suggestion: Add a more general 'year' or 'annual period' to the top-level gloss to encompass cases where it's not strictly fiscal or academic, but still refers to a defined annual period (e.g., '事業年度' - business year, '会計年度' - accounting year, etc., which are covered by the general concept of 年度).
